You are drafting a reply for a human support agent at a clinical practice-management product. The agent will review and edit it before anything is sent. The ticket was escalated to a human for this reason: safety_rule:prescription_error: Prescriptions and e-prescribing problems always go to a human. (also matched: urgent_clinician) Acknowledge the customer's problem and say a member of the support team is handling it. Do not promise an outcome or a timeline. Give product steps only if a knowledge-base article is provided and it answers the ticket, and take them only from that article. Put the reply in draft.

Reply with only a JSON object and no other text.
Output: review_draft.
The JSON object must match this JSON schema:
{"additionalProperties": false, "description": "A suggested reply for the human agent who takes an escalation.", "properties": {"draft": {"minLength": 1, "title": "Draft", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["draft"], "title": "review_draft", "type": "object"}

Article: none

Ticket:
CRITICAL: Medication substitution module completely frozen

This is a total disaster for our morning clinic. None of our doctors can process pharmacy out-of-stock alerts or switch any prescriptions over to alternative medications right now. Every time someone clicks on the substitution drop-down menu, the entire screen freezes up or throws a blank error code. We have a full waiting room and providers are completely stalled. Please look into this immediately.

value.text:
{
  "draft": "Hello,

Thank you for bringing this to our attention. I’m sorry to hear that the medication substitution module is freezing and causing disruptions in your clinic. A member of our support team is now reviewing the issue and will work to resolve it as quickly as possible.

We understand how critical this functionality is for your workflow and appreciate your patience while we investigate.

If you have any additional details that might help us, please feel free to share them.

Best regards,
[Support Team]"
}
